Nina (FinOps): Hey team — quick follow-up from the billing postmortem. Root cause = delayed batch replays that caused inflated token counts for a handful of customers. We need owners for: (1) prod backfill, (2) invoice corrections, (3) automated recurrence detection, (4) customer comms.
Omar (Eng): I can take prod backfill. Plan: small patch to prevent reprocessing, run staging smoke tonight, backfill tomorrow 03:00 UTC.
Priya (Metering): Ill own recurrence detection + alerting. Proposal: alert if delta >=7% over 6h (page) or >=4% over 24h (slack). Add 2-bucket confirmation to reduce noise.
Quentin (SRE): Ill handle invoice correction tooling and the reconcile playbook. Need impacted invoice list from FinOps and a dry-run slot.
Nina (FinOps): Uploaded impacted_customers.csv to FIN-511. Billing-bot queued reissue job br-20240715-09 (status=pending).
billing-bot: Reissue job queued: br-20240715-09 (FIN-511).
Omar (Eng): Staging smoke passed. Quick validation query used:
```
SELECT customer_id, date_trunc('hour', ts) hr, SUM(tokens) tokens
FROM token_events
WHERE ts >= now() - interval '14 days'
GROUP BY customer_id, hr
ORDER BY tokens DESC
LIMIT 40;
```
Priya (Metering): PR opened for detection + dashboard: github.com/redwood/meters/pull/457. Adding example notebooks for edge cases.
Quentin (SRE): Reconcile script draft at //ops/billing/reconcile_v2.sh. Dry-run scheduled Mon 08:30 UTC; will post results.
Nina (FinOps): Deadlines recap: Omar - patch + staging (today), prod backfill (tomorrow 03:00 UTC). Priya - detection rules + dashboards (Fri AM). Quentin - reconcile tooling + dry-run (Mon 08:30 UTC). Finance will draft comms after dry-run. Please update this thread as milestones complete. :+1:
